purpose: Non-reachability review behind the 2026-09-29 [[IgnoredVulns]] entries in .github/osv-scanner.toml for GHSA-hj66-6f7g-4r5v, GHSA-xpv3-w29h-x7cv and GHSA-w6j9-cwv2-h6wq, and behind the IGNORE_ALLOWED_LOCKS entries in tests/test_osv_lockfile_coverage.py that bind them to the two lock digests below. Published on 2026-09-29, the three advisories failed the required osv-scanner check: every pull_request run of security-scan.yml after publication failed with the five findings recorded below (osv_scanner.ci_pull_request_runs).
evidence_class: Local runs of the security-scan.yml OSV-Scanner command on this host, not CI runs; the CI failures are read from GitHub Actions run logs (gh run view --log-failed). The rest is a static text search of package artifacts whose sha256 each lock lists: it shows which installed code references the vulnerable APIs, not a runtime trace of what a process executed.
limitations: Static text search of .py files: a name assembled at run time (getattr, importlib with a computed string) would not match.
Code the OpenHands agent itself writes and runs inside its container is out of scope: the recipe venv is first on that container's PATH, and such code can call any installed API.
The Lumibot lock hashes a locally built ibapi 9.81.1.post1 wheel that PyPI does not serve; the PyPI sdist of the same version was searched instead, and its digest is PyPI's, not the lock's.
Direct users came from each pinned release's requires_dist on PyPI's JSON API; the full-lock sweep also covers packages that import oauthlib or jwt without declaring it.
The OSV database is the live API at scan time.

advisories.summary: Unsafe JSONP callback injection in RevocationEndpoint allows arbitrary JavaScript response generation
advisories.vulnerable_code: oauthlib 3.3.1 oauthlib/oauth2/rfc6749/endpoints/revocation.py:31 and 36 (enable_jsonp=False by default), 72-73 and 81-82 (the response body is wrapped in request.callback when enable_jsonp is set). The pre-configured servers in oauthlib/oauth2/rfc6749/endpoints/pre_configured.py:92, 145, 188, 239 and 282 and oauthlib/openid/connect/core/endpoints/pre_configured.py:137 call RevocationEndpoint.__init__ without enable_jsonp.

advisories.summary: Timing attack in the PKCE code_verifier comparison
advisories.vulnerable_code: oauthlib 3.3.1 oauthlib/oauth2/rfc6749/grant_types/authorization_code.py:18 (code_challenge_method_s256) and 52 (code_challenge_method_plain), comparing with == at lines 49 and 61; mapped at 156-157 and dispatched by validate_code_challenge (544-546), which AuthorizationCodeGrant.validate_token_request (434) calls at line 506 when a token endpoint handles a request (create_token_response, 283).

advisories.summary: Malformed RSA JWK aborts parsing of an entire JWK Set
advisories.vulnerable_code: PyJWT 2.13.0 jwt/api_jwk.py:19 (PyJWK) and 135 (PyJWKSet, constructed at 162 and 167); jwt/jwks_client.py:17 (PyJWKClient), 137 (get_jwk_set) and 158 (PyJWKSet.from_dict of the fetched JWKS).
